item.title: Gunmen abduct three children in Ebonyi
item.description: The Police Command in Ebonyi State have confirmed the abduction of three children by suspected kidnappers.The State Police Public Relations Officer, SP Joshua Ukandu, told the News Agency of Nigeria on Sunday in Abakaliki that the children were abducted on Saturday morning.Ukandu said the incident occurred at Nkwegu, opposite the Nkwegu Military Cantonment gate, in Abakaliki Local Government Area of the state.“Yes, we are aware of the incident. item.description: The Nigerian Senate will hold an emergency plenary sitting on Tuesday, February 10, 2026, following directives from Senate President Godswill Akpabio.A statement signed by the Clerk of the Senate, Emmanuel Odo, announced the reconvening of the upper chamber. item.title: Tinubu To Meet King Charles, Pay State Visit To UK
item.description: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu will undertake a historic two-day state visit to the United Kingdom from March 18 to 19, 2026, marking the first formal state visit by a Nigerian leader to Britain in 37 years.The visit comes at the invitation of King Charles III, who will host President Tinubu and First Lady Senator Oluremi Tinubu at Windsor Castle, west of London, alongside Queen Camilla.
